events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) gathers the pass on his left foot and takes two steps, establishing his right foot as his pivot, which he maintains.
Jokic (DEN) is in the lane for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Sochan (SAS) brings his forearms to Murray's (DEN) body and then releases as he rolls towards the basket after setting the pick. The contact that occurs is marginal.
Following the DHO, Sochan (SAS) releases and makes marginal contact with Murray's (DEN) body as he pivots and rolls towards the basket.
Murray (DEN) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Westbrook (DEN) slightly extends his arm backwards and grazes Paul's (SAS) arm as he defends him during his drive, the contact is considered marginal.
The ball is last touched by Wembanyama (SAS) prior to it going out of bounds.
Paul (SAS) is moving alongside Westbrook's (DEN) path when both players come together during the drive as the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Wembanyama (SAS) initiates contact to Jokic's (DEN) arm before the gather at the end of the drive, which affects Jokic's SQBR.
Watson (DEN) moves alongside Wembanyama's (SAS) path as both players come together after the gather. Watson then cleanly blocks Wembanyama's driving shot attempt.
Westbrook (DEN) swipes down and makes contact with Wembanyama's lower body, which is marginal.
Westbrook (DEN) reaches in and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Johnson (SAS) during his shot attempt in the lane, any additional contact that occurs after the dislodge is deemed incidental.
Barnes (SAS) keeps a resting hand on Jokic's (DEN) body as he starts his upward shooting motion in the post, the contact is considered marginal.
Johnson (SAS) makes marginal contact with Watson's (DEN) body as the pair moves through the lane for the rebound.
Jokic (DEN) reaches in and initiates contact to Paul's (SAS) arm in the backcourt, which affects his SQBR.
Westbrook (DEN) reaches in and initiates contact to Vassell's body using his forearm, which affects Vassell's driving shot attempt. The contact occurs after his gather.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in Paul's (SAS) path when he absorbs the incoming contact as the pick is set.

While contesting the jump shot attempt, Wembanyama (SAS) jumps short of Jokic's (DEN) landing area and to his side. Some marginal contact occurs after the pair return to the floor and Wembanyama brushes Jokic's body.
